stem_book: A small sphere (solid) rolls down without slipping from rest at the top of a track in a vertical plane. The track has an elevated section and a horizontal part. The horizontal part is 1 m above ground level and top of track is 2.4 m above the ground. Find the distance (in m) on the ground w.r.t. B where the sphere lands (B is vertically below the end of the horizontal part). (Take g = 10 m/s².)
reason: solid sphere, start from rest, g = 10 and B's position made explicit
